bundle.shortDescription: A native Markdown, AsciiDoc, Typst and HTML editor
bundle.longDescription: A native Markdown, AsciiDoc, Typst and HTML editor with live preview, math, diagrams and syntax highlighting. It adds an optional AI writing assistant, tabbed documents that remember their undo and scroll state, favorites, typography presets, and HTML, PDF and pandoc export — with no account and no telemetry.
